Hybrid camber patent: Never Summer was awarded the first patent on any type of hybrid camber technology [20] 16. Powder float: Universally praised as effortless and exceptional [95][96] 143. Tree riding: Described as "about as perfect as it gets" for trees [97] 144. Versatility: Multiple users describe it as a "quiver killer" — capable daily driver beyond just powder [98] 145. Build quality: Noted for excellent quality, fit and finish [99] 146. Groomer carving: Surprisingly good on groomers despite powder focus [100] 147. Maneuverability: Quick turn initiation, nimble, easy to control in tight terrain [101] 148.
